hook: A brand-new open-weights language model just dropped — and it runs on a single laptop.
key_points: Astra-2B is a 2-billion-parameter model released under a permissive open license.
It scores competitively on common reasoning benchmarks for its size class.
Quantized builds fit in under 2 GB of memory, so it runs on consumer hardware.
The release includes evaluation scripts and a model card with known limitations.
title: Astra-2B: A New Open-Weights Model (Example Topic)
